SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PHONENUMBER AS phone, u.COMPANY_NO AS companyNo, c.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, r.ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus, u.SIGNUP_DATE AS signupDate FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN COMPANY c ON u.COMPANY_NO = c.COMPANY_NO LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON u.USER_NO = r.USER_NO
WHERE u.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY u.SIGNUP_DATE DESC

SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PHONENUMBER AS phone, u.COMPANY_NO AS companyNo, c.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, r.ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus, u.SIGNUP_DATE AS signupDate FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN COMPANY c ON u.COMPANY_NO = c.COMPANY_NO LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON u.USER_NO = r.USER_NO WHERE u.USER_NO = #{userNo}
